title: Automatic zap detection: zap with the remote, no code to write
description:
Zap with the remote and VirtualPyTest detects it on its own. The backend watches every captured frame, spots the channel change, and measures how long it took: no script, no code, no one watching the screen.

What you see:
1. A set-top box, live. Turn on monitoring: the backend analyses every frame.
2. Zap with the remote. Nothing else: no script, no code.
3. Detected automatically: the new channel and programme, 2.0 s zap time, 0.4 s of freeze, 0.6 s of silence.
4. Its report: the frame at the key press, the freeze start and end, and the new channel.
5. The numbers, measured on every zap.
